questions.question: How do you handle a strong disagreement between two senior engineers on technical strategy?
questions.ideal_answer: Listen actively to both perspectives individually to understand underlying technical concerns and goals. Bring them together to focus on facts, user requirements, and system trade-offs. Use prototyping, benchmarking, or ADRs (Architecture Decision Records) to make objective decisions.
key_points: Focuses on objective data and project goals rather than personalities
Encourages active listening and mutual respect
Uses small spikes/benchmarks to resolve technical stalemates
Ensures buy-in so the team moves forward cohesively
